brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested a child from Bitunya, a town west of Ramallah, on Monday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The arrest took place during an operation in the area, though further details about the circumstances were not immediately disclosed.

The identity of the detained child and the reasons for the arrest remain unclear. Bitunya has been a flashpoint for Israeli military operations and Palestinian resistance activities in the occupied West Bank. The arrest adds to a pattern of detention operations by Israeli forces in communities surrounding Ramallah.
